decisions.question: Which one should I wire in?
decisions.context:
Which error tracking service should the web app use? Sentry is hosted, free to 5k errors/month, then $26/month, with session replay. GlitchTip is self-hosted on our VPS, free, but we patch and back it up ourselves (about an hour a month). Which one should I wire in?

- Sentry (Recommended): Hosted, free up to 5k errors a month, then $26/month. Session replay included. No ops work.
- GlitchTip (self-hosted): Free, runs on our VPS. We patch and back it up ourselves, about an hour a month.
